create_ocr_config: create a PPOCRV5MobileDetConfig instance for PP-OCRv5 mobile detection model initialization
build_backbone_config: build a default PP-LCNet-V3 backbone config with scale 0.75 and four output stages for the OCR detector
configure_neck_channels: configure neck output channels and interpolation mode for multi-scale feature fusion in the detection head
set_reduction_factor: set the reduction factor and kernel list to control channel dimensions and multi-scale text region extraction
